notes.title: Version 1.7.45 released
notes.content:
Changes:
• Fixed bug where shelled convoy ships (hit or near miss) would sometimes report incorrect player position to escorts (who would then race excitedly off to the completely wrong place).
• Cleared leaderboards (due to difficulty change from above bug fix).
• Prevent ships from being knocked permanently askew by collisions.

notes.title: Version 1.7.43 released
notes.content:
Changes:
• Random Mission: Convoys will always have at least 3 transports (no more single-escort missions!)
• Random Mission: Convoys will never be angled further than 90 degrees from player. 
• Fixed Challenge 2 (“surface attack, night”) so it’s actually at night. Because night attacks work better at night.

notes.title: V1.7.42 released
notes.content: Fixes a bug where your sub would “pop” up or down when unpausing after leaving the game paused for a lengthy period. If the “pop” was downward, it could cause instant implosion, which most would consider a Bad Thing.

notes.title: V1.7.37 released
notes.content:
The only major change in this version is that you can now pan around in the Patrol Map (it basically behaves like a super-zoomed-out Map View).
Single click/touch to set a new destination, or click-drag to pan. Hit the "Center View" button at the bottom left to re-center on your sub.

This version uses new leaderboards, since this change affects difficulty.

notes.title: v 1.7.1 released
notes.content:
Version 1.7.1 has been released.
• Enemy ships now collide with each other (but do not damage each other).
• Enemy escorts no longer hold fire when another enemy ship is in line of fire.
• Fixed shimmy when sub is moving at 16x time-scale.
• Convoy ship start positions staggered laterally.
• Max convoy transport count increased to 9 (was 8).
• Fixed bug where left rudder button would always be in "Toggle" mode.
• Fixed bug where throttle UI would not match actual throttle setting.
• Fixed bug where enemy escorts would sometimes pretend to be submarines.
• Fixed bug where in-game options Volume would be 1/100 of actual volume value.
